entities.name: Ari Shokta
entities.description: Stern, affectionate Gruul warrior on Ravnica and mother of Araithia Shokta.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Ari's daughter, a capable spy who conceals herself with an enchantment.

entities.name: Boruvo
entities.description: Centaur, Rat's godfather, who defected to Selesnya.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon resurrected in a ritual Ari attended.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: Rat's new friend who protected the group from Eternals.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Former Gruul leader absent from the new guild.

events.summary: Ari raises Rat as Gruul, but her relationship with Boruvo soured after his defection.
events.quote: since Rat's godfather Boruvo defected to Selesnya

events.summary: During the War of the Spark, Rat returns home and Ari hugs her tightly.
events.quote: Ari scolded Rat for shouting but then hugged her tightly

events.summary: Rat tells Ari that Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting; Ari helps mediate and attends the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: She was present during the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: Teyo Verada protects the group from Eternals and Ari praises him.
events.quote: Ari acknowledged his efforts and praised him

events.summary: Ari survives the War of the Spark and joins the new Gruul guild without Domri Rade.
events.quote: Ari survived the War of the Spark

relations.quote: Ari Shokta is a Gruul warrior on the plane of Ravnica , and mother of Araithia Shokta
Ari Shokta is a Gruul warrior
